l4_steps.name: Evaluate co-brand bank partner candidates
l4_steps.input: Bank RFP responses, cardholder portfolio data, credit union benchmarks
l4_steps.output: Partner shortlist with scored evaluation matrix
l4_steps.kpi: Partner evaluation cycle ≤60 days; minimum 3 candidates scored
l4_steps.pain_point: Airline loyalty platforms (e.g., Comarch Loyalty) lack native RFP workflow tooling — scoring is manual in spreadsheets, creating audit gaps for legal review

l4_steps.name: Negotiate revenue-share and miles pricing terms
l4_steps.input: Partner shortlist, actuarial breakage model, competitive miles CPM benchmarks
l4_steps.output: Agreed term sheet: miles CPM, sign-up bonus pool, revenue-share %
l4_steps.kpi: Miles CPM negotiated ≥$0.011 per mile; sign-up bonus cost per card ≤$120
l4_steps.pain_point: Breakage assumptions differ between airline actuary and bank models — misalignment inflates miles liability on SAP S/4HANA FI balance sheet by up to 15%

l4_steps.name: Execute partnership agreement and integration SLA
l4_steps.input: Signed term sheet, legal review, PCI-DSS compliance checklist
l4_steps.output: Executed co-brand agreement, data-sharing addendum, SLA schedules
l4_steps.kpi: Contract execution ≤90 days from term sheet; SLA uptime commitment ≥99.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: PCI-DSS and GDPR/CCPA data-sharing clauses require iterative legal review — delays frequently push launch dates 4–8 weeks beyond plan

l4_steps.name: Define card tier earn rates and bonus categories
l4_steps.input: Executed partnership agreement, competitive card benchmarking (OAG / Phocuswire reports)
l4_steps.output: Earn rate table: base miles/$ per spend category, bonus multipliers per tier
l4_steps.kpi: Earn rate design approved by actuary within 10 business days; ≥3 spend bonus categories defined
l4_steps.pain_point: Earn rule complexity (dining, travel, grocery multipliers) creates combinatorial edge cases in Comarch rule engine — insufficient QA leads to overpayment incidents

l4_steps.name: Configure earn rules in loyalty management platform
l4_steps.input: Earn rate table, card BIN ranges from bank processor (Visa/Mastercard)
l4_steps.output: Live earn rule configuration in loyalty platform, BIN-mapped to card product
l4_steps.kpi: Rule configuration UAT pass rate ≥98%; zero overpayment defects in regression suite
l4_steps.pain_point: BIN range changes during card reissue cycles (e.g., chip migration) are not proactively communicated by Visa/Mastercard — stale BIN mapping causes missed miles posts

l4_steps.name: Validate earn rules against PSS booking data
l4_steps.input: Comarch earn rule config, synthetic test transaction set, Altéa member profiles
l4_steps.output: Validation report: earn accuracy %, exception count, sign-off for go-live
l4_steps.kpi: Miles earn accuracy ≥99.9% in UAT; <5 exception cases per 1,000 test transactions
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa loyalty module integration requires custom API adapter for co-brand transactions — adapter versioning lags Altéa PSS upgrades, causing earn rule regressions post-patch

l4_steps.name: Certify integration with bank card processor
l4_steps.input: Bank-issued API credentials, PCI-DSS network diagram, certification test plan
l4_steps.output: Certified integration: bank transaction feed → loyalty platform; go/no-go decision
l4_steps.kpi: Certification completed ≤30 days; API response latency ≤200ms p99
l4_steps.pain_point: Bank processor certification environments are infrequently refreshed — test data does not reflect production edge cases, leading to post-launch transaction failures

l4_steps.name: Receive daily transaction file from bank partner
l4_steps.input: Bank-generated SFTP daily transaction file (ISO 8583 or proprietary format)
l4_steps.output: Ingested transaction file in AWS S3 data lake; ingestion audit log
l4_steps.kpi: File receipt by 06:00 local time daily; file completeness ≥99.95% of expected records
l4_steps.pain_point: Bank SFTP file delivery SLAs are frequently breached (5–10 min late) — cascading delay into daily miles posting batch impacts member experience for same-day redemptions

l4_steps.name: Match cardholder to loyalty programme member
l4_steps.input: Daily transaction file, loyalty member master (Comarch), name/DOB/email match keys
l4_steps.output: Matched transaction set; unmatched exception queue for manual review
l4_steps.kpi: Member match rate ≥99.2%; unmatched queue resolved within 48 hours
l4_steps.pain_point: Name discrepancies between bank card embossing (legal name) and loyalty profile (preferred name) cause false negatives — no automated fuzzy-match in current Comarch-Redshift pipeline

l4_steps.name: Calculate miles earned per matched transaction
l4_steps.input: Matched transactions, earn rule table, merchant category codes (MCC)
l4_steps.output: Miles calculation ledger: member ID, transaction ID, miles awarded
l4_steps.kpi: Miles calculation accuracy ≥99.99%; batch processing completed within 2 hours of file receipt
l4_steps.pain_point: MCC mapping inconsistencies from Visa/Mastercard network (e.g., new fintech merchants with catch-all MCCs) result in incorrect bonus tier application — no real-time MCC correction feed

l4_steps.name: Post miles to member loyalty account
l4_steps.input: Miles calculation ledger, member account status (active/suspended/expired)
l4_steps.output: Posted miles on member account; transaction confirmation email triggered
l4_steps.kpi: Miles posting within 24 hours of transaction date; member notification sent ≤1 hour post-post
l4_steps.pain_point: Suspended accounts (fraud hold by bank) do not trigger Comarch status sync — miles post to suspended accounts creating redemption liability that cannot be fulfilled

l4_steps.name: Execute co-brand card acquisition campaign
l4_steps.input: Approved campaign brief, member segmentation (Redshift cohorts), bank co-op budget
l4_steps.output: Live campaign: email, in-app, boarding pass inserts; click/apply tracking UTMs
l4_steps.kpi: Campaign conversion rate ≥2.5% of targeted members; cost per new card account ≤$85
l4_steps.pain_point: Boarding pass insert channel requires coordination with PSS vendor (Altéa) for printing logic — lead time is 6 weeks, making last-minute promotional changes impossible

l4_steps.name: Validate welcome bonus eligibility for new cardholders
l4_steps.input: New cardholder activation event from bank, minimum spend threshold rules
l4_steps.output: Eligibility flag: welcome bonus approved or pending spend threshold
l4_steps.kpi: Welcome bonus activation within 5 business days of threshold met; ≤0.1% erroneous bonus grants
l4_steps.pain_point: Bank spend threshold data arrives in arrears (T+3 days) — members who query missing welcome bonus generate high CSAT complaints before data is available

l4_steps.name: Activate welcome bonus miles for eligible cardholders
l4_steps.input: Eligibility approval flag, welcome bonus amount per card product tier
l4_steps.output: Welcome bonus miles credited to member account; confirmation notification sent
l4_steps.kpi: Welcome bonus credited ≤24 hours of eligibility approval; zero duplicate grants in batch
l4_steps.pain_point: Idempotency controls in Comarch bonus posting API are not enforced at the bank feed layer — duplicate activation events from bank cause double-grant incidents requiring costly manual reversal

l4_steps.name: Reconcile miles sold to bank vs miles posted
l4_steps.input: Comarch miles posting ledger, bank-reported miles purchase invoice, AWS Redshift audit log
l4_steps.output: Reconciliation report: matched/unmatched miles, variance %, discrepancy log
l4_steps.kpi: Monthly reconciliation variance ≤0.05% of total miles posted; reconciliation completed by day 5 of following month
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP FI miles liability account uses standard cost per mile — market-rate fluctuations in miles CPM are not reflected until year-end revaluation, distorting monthly P&L by up to $2M

l4_steps.name: Invoice bank partner for miles purchased
l4_steps.input: Reconciled miles volume, agreed CPM rate from contract, applicable taxes/fees
l4_steps.output: AR invoice issued to bank partner in SAP; payment terms triggered (Net 30)
l4_steps.kpi: Invoice issued within 3 business days of reconciliation sign-off; DSO ≤35 days
l4_steps.pain_point: Bank disputes over MCC-categorised bonus miles (billed at higher CPM) are frequent — lack of automated MCC audit trail in SAP AR module prolongs dispute resolution to 60+ days

l4_steps.name: Generate quarterly partnership performance report
l4_steps.input: AWS Redshift (card spend, miles earned, member acquisition, redemption rates), SAP FI revenue data
l4_steps.output: QBR deck: card acquisition, active cardholder rate, miles revenue, breakage %, churn
l4_steps.kpi: Active cardholder rate ≥65% (spent in last 90 days); miles revenue per active card ≥$180/yr
l4_steps.pain_point: No single source of truth for 'active cardholder' definition — Comarch, Altéa, and bank definitions diverge, causing QBR figures to be challenged by bank partner and delaying review sign-off

l4_steps.name: Conduct annual contract review and renegotiation
l4_steps.input: QBR performance history, breakage actuary update, competitive co-brand benchmarks, CPM market data
l4_steps.output: Renewed or renegotiated contract terms; updated SLA schedules in Salesforce
l4_steps.kpi: Contract renewal completed ≥90 days before expiry; CPM improvement ≥3% vs prior term
l4_steps.pain_point: Airline bargaining leverage is limited without alliance membership — bank partners benchmark co-brand terms against carriers with larger frequent flyer bases, compressing CPM improvement potential
